reserved_evaluation.scope_of_transfer: new sizes and queue orders within two known synthetic families; not new task families

schedule: For case index i and budget index j, shuffle three copies of balanced_arm_orders with seed + 1000*i + j. For repetition r, shuffle all case/budget blocks with seed + r; execute each block's four arms consecutively using its r-th order. Case order is prior development manifest followed by reserved profiles and orderings as listed.
execution: serial fresh processes; one query per process; no inference warmup; no concurrent tests or other experiment workers
primary_endpoint: on-time independently verified answers at every prespecified tight budget, reported separately by split and case
secondary_endpoint: paired first-answer CPU at the separate generous endpoint, with all failures retained
query_clock: engine process CPU through complete return, including embedded Python classification and all online selection overhead
deadline_policy: cooperative checks between expansions; retain actual CPU and overshoot; late answers are misses
failure_policy: retain invalid executions separately from valid deadline, late-return and exhausted outcomes; stop at three invalid executions; never replace measurements or claim completion for a partial batch
freeze_policy: Generate and qualify all trajectories from current code; freeze sources, fixtures and schedule before measurement. Never overwrite an existing run.
evaluation_status: All 27 cases are now observed; their historical split labels do not imply a fresh holdout.
